scope: Read-only B8 trajectory/posterior and full-scan-functional diagnosis; no model, acquisition, threshold, observation, IOC or machine changes
native_summary: Exact B8 seed/sample count and stable_seed(summary,policy_seed,M0,active_step); compare all summary fields
metrics: Exclusive candidate invalidity partition: nonfinite/nonpositive curve, nonfinite moments, nonpositive covariance diagonal, nonpositive determinant, physical
Output invalidity partition: no positive curve candidate vs positive curves but no physical covariance candidate
Per-query Gaussian negative-variance mass, observed/unobserved, descriptive residual vs finite primary reference
Expected curve energy outside span of the transport design; no samples projected or changed
Exact fixed-kernel scale components and observation-jitter ratios
Original and enhanced posterior physicality; enhanced Monte Carlo Wilson intervals condition on each fitted posterior
Weighted-reference vs existing unweighted M0 full-scan functional, fixed-energy vs entrance-momentum normalization
model_maps: Rebuild 18 transport matrices in private temporary workspaces; require exact pool fingerprints before checkpoint replay; no particle tracking
inference_policy: No parameter sweep, gate relaxation, posterior clipping, sample rejection, model edits or performance claims. Preserve B8 outcome. Monte Carlo intervals quantify sampling of a fitted posterior only.
continuation: Report supported causes, unresolved causal questions and one concrete next bounded model/target-consistency investigation; no new policy benchmark.
